sentence: ____（你一回到家）, please send me an e-mail.
accepts: As soon as you get home
As soon as you get back home
As soon as you return home
As soon as you arrive home
point: as soon as 引导时间状语从句
explain: as soon as 意为“一……就……”，从句遵循主祈从现。

sentence: The box is ____（太重了以至于搬不动）for the little girl.
point: too...to... 句型
explain: too...to... 表示“太……而不能……”，后接动词原形。

sentence: He ran ____（如此快以至于）nobody could catch up with him.
point: so...that 结果状语从句
explain: so+副词+that 引导结果状语从句，意为“如此……以至于……”。

sentence: ____（花了我们两小时）to finish the English test yesterday.
point: it takes sb. some time to do sth. 句型
explain: it takes sb. time to do 表示“做某事花费某人多长时间”，过去式用 took。

sentence: He ____（不仅喜欢音乐而且喜欢）sports.
accepts: not only likes music but also
likes not only music but also
point: not only...but also... 并列结构
explain: not only...but also... 连接并列宾语，意为“不仅……而且……”。

sentence: We will go camping tomorrow ____（如果不下雨的话）.
point: 条件状语从句（主将从现）
explain: if/unless 引导条件状语从句，主将从现，从句用一般现在时。
prompt: We will go camping ____（如果不下雨的话）tomorrow.

sentence: ____（尽管他很累）, he still went on working.
point: 让步状语从句
explain: although/though 引导让步从句，且不能与 but 连用。

sentence: My uncle ____（已经住在这里）for more than ten years.
point: 现在完成时
explain: 根据 for+时间段 可知用现在完成时，主语单数用 has lived。

sentence: The new bridge over the river ____（是去年建成的）.
point: 一般过去时的被动语态
explain: bridge 与 build 是被动关系，根据 last year 用 was built。
prompt: The new bridge over the river ____（是去年建成的）.

sentence: Jack is ____（和……一样高）his father now.
point: 同级比较 as...as
explain: as+形容词原级+as 表示“和……一样”，肯定句用 as...as。

sentence: The harder you study, ____（你就会越进步）in the exam.
accepts: the more progress you will make
point: the more...the more 句型
explain: “the+比较级..., the+比较级...”表示“越……就越……”。

sentence: We are all ____（期盼着收到）your reply soon.
point: look forward to doing sth. 短语
explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词形式。

sentence: She ____（擅长弹钢琴）when she was a child.
accepts: was good at playing the piano
did well in playing the piano
point: be good at 短语及过去时
explain: be good at doing 表示“擅长做某事”，根据 was 可知用 was good at。

sentence: You should ____（好好照顾你的妹妹）at home.
accepts: take good care of your sister
take good care of your younger sister
take good care of your little sister
look after your younger sister well
look after your little sister well
point: take good care of 短语
explain: take good care of 意为“好好照顾”，情态动词 should 后用原形。

sentence: The doctor advised him to ____（戒烟）for his health.
point: give up doing 搭配
explain: advise sb. to do sth.，且 give up/stop 后接动名词表示戒掉。

sentence: This is the teacher ____（教我们英语的）in our school.
point: 定语从句先行词为人
explain: 先行词 teacher 为人，关系代词用 who/that，从句谓语用单三式。

sentence: I don't know ____（他是否会来）to the party tonight.
point: 宾语从句引导词
explain: whether/if 引导宾语从句表示“是否”，从句用陈述语序和将来时。

sentence: Can you tell me ____（火车站怎么走）?
accepts: how to get to the railway station
the way to the railway station
how I can get to the railway station
how to go to the railway station
point: 疑问词+不定式/宾语从句
explain: how to get to 表示“如何到达”，get to the railway station 为固定搭配。

sentence: He was tired, so he stopped ____（喝杯水）by the road.
accepts: to drink a cup of water
to drink a glass of water
to have a drink of water
point: stop to do sth. 搭配
explain: stop to do sth. 表示“停下来去做另一件事”。

sentence: Chinese ____（被广泛使用）by millions of people today.
point: 一般现在时的被动语态
explain: 客观事实用一般现在时，be widely used 意为“被广泛使用”。

sentence: I didn't notice ____（你在说什么）just now.
point: what 引导宾语从句
explain: what 引导宾语从句并充当宾语，根据 just now 从句用过去时态。

sentence: Grandpa ____（习惯于早起）every morning.
accepts: is used to getting up early
is accustomed to getting up early
point: be used to doing sth. 短语
explain: be used to doing sth. 意为“习惯于做某事”，to 为介词后接动名词。

sentence: She ____（花了很多钱在衣服上）last weekend.
accepts: spent a lot of money on clothes
spent lots of money on clothes
point: spend...on sth. 结构
explain: spend money on sth. 表示“在某物上花钱”，过去式为 spent。

sentence: The book ____（他在读的）is very interesting.
point: 定语从句先行词为物
explain: 先行词 book 为物，关系代词用 that/which，在从句中作宾语也可省略。

sentence: We ____（直到昨晚才完成期末项目）.
accepts: didn't finish the final project until last night
did not finish the final project until last night
didn't complete the final project until last night
did not complete the final project until last night
point: not...until 结构
explain: not...until 表示“直到……才……”，主句用否定，until 后接时间。
prompt: We ____（直到昨晚才完成期末项目）.

sentence: This computer is ____（比那台昂贵得多）.
accepts: much more expensive than that one
far more expensive than that one
point: 比较级修饰语及比较结构
explain: expensive 比较级为 more expensive，much 用于修饰比较级表示程度大。

sentence: Don't forget ____（关掉电灯）before you leave the classroom.
point: forget to do sth. 搭配
explain: forget to do sth. 表示“记得去做（未做的事）”，turn off 意为关掉。

sentence: ____（学好一门外语是重要的）for your future work.
accepts: It is important to learn a foreign language well
It's important to learn a foreign language well
It is important to study a foreign language well
It's important to study a foreign language well
point: it is+adj.+to do sth. 句型
explain: it 充当形式主语，真正的主语是不定式短语 to learn...

sentence: I don't know ____（桌上这本书属于谁）.
point: 宾语从句及 belong to 搭配
explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序，belong to 意为“属于”，主语是单数用 belongs。
prompt: Do you know ____（这本书属于谁）?

sentence: ____（在回家的路上）, I met my primary school teacher.
point: on one's way home 介词短语
explain: on one's/the way home 意为“在回家路上”，home 为副词前不加 to。
